footnote_text: Transaction made pursuant to a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan established by the reporting person on March 27, 2026.  As previously disclosed, Mr. Anderson retired from his position as CEO of NW Holdings and NW Natural, effective April 1, 2025.  At the time the 10b5-1 Plan was established, Mr. Anderson held more than 7 times the then-current $450,000 stock ownership requirements for non-management directors.  This trading arrangement allows Mr. Anderson to periodically sell a portion of his NW Holdings common stock to diversify his holdings in connection with his retirement. || This transaction was executed in multiple trades on reported date with prices ranging from $47.9550 to $48.2100, resulting in a weighted average price of $48.0259.
